evidence.finding: README describes persistent teams, local use, MIT, CLI/desktop install, and default-on anonymous telemetry with agx telemetry off. It also broadly promises code never leaves and approval before irreversible actions. Those promises require qualification against actual launch/transmission code.

evidence.title: AGX: README.md
evidence.finding: README License section labels project MIT; package metadata also says MIT. No standalone license file exists in this archive.

evidence.title: AGX: package.json
evidence.finding: Node CLI entry and dependencies; version 2.4.11.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/desktop/package.json
evidence.finding: Electron packaging config targets macOS DMG/ZIP; no Windows/Linux desktop targets in this package.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/package.json
evidence.finding: Local operational dashboard uses Next16, React19, node-pty, SQLite and WebSockets on Node22.16+.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/mobile/ipad/agx/WebView.swift
evidence.finding: iPad source uses WKWebView with persistent data store and user-selected host URL.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/mobile/android/app/src/main/java/com/agx/mobile/MainActivity.kt
evidence.finding: Android source lists configurable hosts and embeds a WebView; it is a companion to the user-hosted dashboard.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/mobile/android/README.md
evidence.finding: Source build instructions and Android requirements; no verified store distribution is established.

evidence.title: AGX: lib/cli/providers.js
evidence.finding: Installed Claude, Gemini, Codex, Ollama and ZAI setup. ZAI uses configured API credentials; Ollama setup can select a cloud-labelled model, so Ollama is not inherently offline.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/cli-runner.ts
evidence.locator: 350–477 provider command factory; 650–780 spawn, abort and timeout handling
evidence.finding: The command factory launches Claude, Codex, Gemini and Kimi executables; Ollama is a model runner and ZAI invokes Claude with an endpoint override. Claude uses --dangerously-skip-permissions, Codex bypasses approvals/sandbox, and Gemini uses --yolo. Home-directory access, streamed output, abort and timeout handling are implemented.

evidence.title: AGX: lib/cli/runCli.js
evidence.finding: CLI exposes task creation/run/reset/checkpoints, project operations, webhook and telemetry settings. --mcp passes a configuration path to compatible harnesses; this is not a product MCP server.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/migrations/sqlite_schema.sql
evidence.finding: Local SQLite schema separates tasks, logs, comments, cost entries, graph nodes, user/project data and agents. Task identity includes project identifier, queued/in_progress/blocked/completed/failed states, priority, engine, dependencies, claims and plan references.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/db/tasks.ts
evidence.finding: Creates stable UUID/project task identifiers with queued status and metadata; updates and deletes local records. Queue selector orders priority and creation; missing task handling is explicit.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/app/api/tasks/[id]/route.ts
evidence.finding: GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE expose task state/content changes via local API; stage aliases map old named workflow stages to INTAKE/PROGRESS/DONE.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/tracker/registry.ts
evidence.finding: Registry binds Jira, Linear and GitHub adapter implementations.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/app/api/trackers/[tracker]/items/[id]/route.ts
evidence.finding: GET reads tracker item; PATCH delegates status/assignee/priority/labels to adapter and updates cached status. External services remain authoritative and differ by adapter.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/vault-store.ts
evidence.locator: 1195–1218 memory writes/deletion; 1307–1382 upsertKnowledgeNote; 1587–1603 deleteLearning; legacy import
evidence.finding: Markdown vault stores global/project/repo/agent knowledge with source IDs, change summaries and incremented versions; identical content is not rewritten. Learning deletion and legacy SQLite import exist. Project variables are written as Markdown values, not an OS vault.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/src/graph/scheduler.ts
evidence.finding: Graph readiness checks typed hard/soft edges and success/failure/any conditions; missing nodes do not satisfy dependencies. Cron schedules are parsed.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/src/graph/gate-verifier.ts
evidence.finding: Graph progress gates auto-pass; quality checks and selected design gates can require review, while handoff/approval gates require a human. These are workflow gates, not every CLI shell action.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/queue/sqlite-adapter.ts
evidence.finding: Transactional SQLite job claims record worker IDs, priority and retry limits. Poll starts asynchronous batches without tracking active promises as a global concurrency cap. Stale active jobs are retried/failed after ten minutes by default.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/worker/index.ts
evidence.finding: Worker registers task batch size five and chat batch size two; validates configured worker count and starts schedule runtime.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/orchestrator/schedule-runtime.ts
evidence.finding: Local server interval runs scheduling with an in-flight poll guard and env disable flag; it is not tied to a browser tab.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/src/graph/schedule-runner.ts
evidence.finding: Active scheduled graphs claim slots, dispatch due function/work nodes, track errors and release slots; excessive failures stop schedules.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/src/graph/work-dispatcher.ts
evidence.finding: Work dispatch reads configured thread/provider/team agent metadata, selects routing order with Claude fallback and invokes runCliResponse.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/app/api/agents/[id]/messages/route.ts
evidence.finding: Reads retained per-agent messages and thread context from local group-chat history.sqlite; agent ID is attribution, not human authentication.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/project-objectives.ts
evidence.finding: Project objective records retain title, team/thread/scheduled-task links, notes, health/progress and activities. No task-to-epic conversion is established.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/mesh-core/feed.ts
evidence.finding: Team feed combines retained agent journal posts, comments and reactions ordered by time.

evidence.title: AGX: lib/notifications/webhooks.js
evidence.finding: Configured outgoing HTTP webhooks post created/stage-complete/completed/failed/blocked task events; wildcard filtering exists. This is not an inbound dispatch webhook.

evidence.title: AGX: lib/cloud-sync.js
evidence.finding: Optional configured endpoint receives checkpoint objective, plan/criterion counts, Git state and blocked reason. No endpoint configured means no checkpoint sync; this is not evidence of managed vendor execution.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/git-workspaces.ts
evidence.finding: Enumerates existing Git worktrees/branches for context; does not provision a task worktree.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/src/prompt-scheduler/task-worker-constants.ts
evidence.finding: Agent prompt instructs worktree creation after planning, testing, commit/push/PR. Native worktree allocation is not established by this instruction.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/auth-mode.ts
evidence.finding: Fixed local user identity; source is single-user local mode.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/src/graph/middleware/authz.ts
evidence.finding: Graph authorization loads the fixed local user and does not establish authenticated multiuser roles.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/github-client.ts
evidence.finding: GitHub API bearer client reads PR metadata, exact head SHA, reviewers/checks and comments. External rate-limit/auth failures are explicit.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/components/prs/review/PrReviewView.tsx
evidence.finding: Review view fetches PR details and renders files/comments in the review layout.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/lib/thread-export.ts
evidence.finding: Thread Markdown export caps newest history at 100000 characters with truncation marker and cleans temporary exports after 24 hours. This is not full history retention TTL.

evidence.title: AGX: lib/telemetry.js
evidence.finding: CLI PostHog is on unless AGX_TELEMETRY=0 or stored config disabled; persistent anonymous UUID and OS/version/command/outcome/timing properties are sent. setEnabled changes config; cached client can persist for current process.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/components/GoogleAnalytics.tsx
evidence.finding: Local-dashboard component loads Google Analytics afterInteractive with configured measurement ID and no consent/CLI telemetry flag check.

evidence.title: AGX: apps/local/app/layout.tsx
evidence.finding: Operational local app root renders GoogleAnalytics; this is not merely a marketing website component.
